rows.outcome: A standard user installs the self-contained MSI without a separate .NET runtime.
The exact installed executable starts and survives an observation interval.
rows.manualEvidence: Tray visibility is a separate row

rows.outcome: Repair restores the same payload while preserving application data.
Uninstall removes installer-owned resources and preserves settings, capture and queue bytes.
The tray icon is visible and Start Menu launch reaches the tray host.
rows.automatedEvidence: Shortcut target and process survival only; CI does not claim visibility
rows.manualEvidence: Interactive tray and Start Menu observation

rows.outcome: A standard user captures test content, reviews locally, quits and relaunches without losing evidence.
rows.automatedEvidence: Existing unit tests and host build
rows.manualEvidence: Interactive clean-profile capture using non-sensitive test content

rows.outcome: A second standard-user profile has independent HKCU registration and Jazz data.
rows.manualEvidence: Two authenticated profile runs linked by run ID; isolation is operator attestation, not automatic cross-profile inspection

rows.outcome: Microphone allow, deny and revoke states are represented honestly.
rows.manualEvidence: Real microphone and Windows privacy settings

rows.outcome: Scaling, mixed displays, elevated targets and secure desktop fail or degrade explicitly.
rows.manualEvidence: 100/150/200% scaling, mixed-display, elevated-target and secure-desktop observations

rows.outcome: Unsigned SmartScreen and organizational policy behavior is recorded, not conflated with MSI correctness.
Upgrade, downgrade, changed-same-version and failing-upgrade rollback are proven with exact packages.
First-run guidance, discoverability, per-user single-instance and newer-only update UX are unified without implicit capture.
rows.automatedEvidence: SID-scoped singleton, activation-only protocol, version and release-parser tests; CI does not claim visible UI
rows.manualEvidence: Clean-profile launch with no window shown, tray status window, tray reopen, second-launch foreground activation, two-profile isolation, update-link observation, a switched launch (JazzCapture.exe --capture-at-launch) recording immediately, and a preset settings.json launch recording immediately with no window and no tray interaction

rows.outcome: Captured events survive a crash, a relaunch, a slow endpoint, or a missing/expired credential via a durable, bounded, on-disk spool, instead of being dropped by the prior non-durable in-memory dispatcher.
rows.automatedEvidence: EventSpoolTests, EventDeliveryWorkerTests, EventStreamRetryPolicyTests, EventDeliveryPresentationTests, EventDeliverySettingsTests, MvpStreamSenderTests, DeliverySecretSafetyTests
rows.manualEvidence: Offline accumulation and recovery, restart survival while offline, capture-without-credential with delivery resuming once provisioned, correlated rows in the Keboola logs table (referenced from issue #65, not claimed here)

rows.outcome: Native ARM64 installation and capture are qualified.
